HOW WISHLY WORKS

From a little idea to
a link worth opening.

Wishly is a browser-based website maker. Start with a template, make it yours and share the finished experience.

01

Choose an experience

Browse designs for birthdays, proposals, wedding invitations, apologies, letters and other meaningful moments. Preview a template before choosing.

02

Make it feel like yours

Use the visual editor to update supported words and media. Depending on the template, add photos, video, audio, a gallery or interactive sections.

03

Preview, publish and share

Check the page as a visitor, publish it and send the link. You can also share using a QR code where available.

✦ Your style, your story

YOUR DESIGN, YOUR WAY

Personal details.
Beautifully presented.

A template gives you a thoughtful starting point. The visual editor helps you replace sample details with your own story, so the final page feels personal rather than generic.

  • Update supported text, names, dates and images.
  • Choose a theme color and font from design settings.
  • Preview the visitor experience before publishing.
  • Keep the published link ready to share with one person or a group.
